The decline came despite strong quarterly results the company posted in September, as Yahoo Finance reported. The CXMT news put the focus on competition in server memory, the product category the Chinese company says it is targeting.


## SK Hynix (SKHY): 9.10% Slide in Seoul After a 4.02% US Drop


SK Hynix's US-listed shares closed down 4.02% on Monday, while Samsung Electronics tumbled 4% in Seoul, per[Yahoo Finance](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/article/micron-sk-hynix-stocks-fall-as-chinese-memory-maker-announces-progress-in-new-design-123824149.html) .


The selling deepened in Korea on Tuesday. As of 10:43 a.m. local time, SK Hynix had plunged 9.10% and Samsung Electronics had dropped 7.09%, according to[BloomingBit](https://en.bloomingbit.io/feed/news/122083) . Foreign selling focused on the two[memory-chip heavyweights](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/news/memory-chip-crunch-amd-samsung-samsung-q3-micron/) , as reported by[KED Global](https://www.kedglobal.com/korean-stock-market/newsView/ked202610130001) .


## Kospi Falls 6.55% Below 6,000 as Foreign Investors Sell 1.98 Trillion Won


The Kospi stood at 5,966.15 at 10:43 a.m. on October 13, down 392.30 points or 6.55% from the previous session, according to[BloomingBit](https://en.bloomingbit.io/feed/news/122083) . The tech-heavy Kosdaq was at 809.40, down 39.79 points or 4.69%.


Foreign investors were net sellers in the first hour and a half of trading, while individuals and institutions were net buyers. BloomingBit reported the following investor flows on the Kospi market for that window:


Investor group Net position, first 1.5 hours (Oct 13)


Foreign investors Net sold 1.9823 trillion won


Individuals Net bought 1.4271 trillion won


Institutions Net bought 518.5 billion won


Foreign investors also sold a net 191.9 billion won of Kospi 200 futures, per BloomingBit. KED Global said the drop below 6,000 triggered the first sell-side trading curb in nearly two months.
